summary: Tested full Tennis Player Auction backend (22 pytest cases) and frontend mobile UI end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 PASS covering auth (register, login, /me, invalid token, missing token), /api/config (14 teams, 98 players, utr_5_5/utr_5_25 auto-skipped count=0, utr_3_0 cap=6), auction lifecycle (6-char sessionId, captains pre-assigned, first effective player from UTR 5.0 @ $12,000), bidding (valid, below-base, bad increment, duplicate unique-bid rule, exceeds-budget, budget-reserve rule), finalize (awards highest bidder, decrements budget, removes player from pool, clears bids, advances index, records acquiredPrice), finalize-no-bids returns 400 'No bids', skip moves player to end with isRetry=true & retryCount=1, reset restores initial state. Frontend: login screen renders, seeded login works, session screen shows health panel (Teams 14/14, Pool players 84, UTR pool counts/caps correct, 5.5/5.25 marked auto-skipped), create-auction navigates to /auction/{sid}, auction screen renders sticky context bar (player + 60s timer countdown), team grid with 14 teams showing $87k/$92k budgets + quick-bid chips ($12k/$13k/$14k) + Bid button + pin/bookmark icon, bottom bar shows Skip/Award. Placed bid via chip-1-12000 → place-bid-1: card highlighted with 'Your bid $12,000 · WINNING' and bottom bar switched from 'No Bids' to 'Award · Team 1'. Clicked finalize-button: player advanced to next UTR 5.0 player (Rajasekhar Karru) and pool count updated to 1/4. No red screen errors, no API failures, no broken images. Console only has benign React 19 deprecation warnings.

issues: After awarding, Team 1 no longer appears at the top of the team grid (Team 2 becomes first visible). This may be intentional sort/dim of teams that just won, but worth confirming with PM/spec.

react_native_issues.issue: Benign: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely from a transitive RN/Expo dependency; not actionable in app code.
Benign: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' — from a transitive lib (likely react-native-safe-area-context or @expo/vector-icons). No functional impact.

action_items: Optional: confirm whether the teams grid should reorder/hide a team immediately after it wins a player (current behaviour was observed but UX intent unclear).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); prefer lifespan context for FastAPI >=0.110. Non-blocking.

/api/auctions/{sid}/reset is not optimistic-concurrency-safe: it directly $set the new doc with version+1 without filtering by current version, unlike commit(). A concurrent bid in-flight could be silently overwritten. Consider matching on version when resetting.

Code is well-structured, all React Native components used correctly (View/Text/Pressable/TextInput), styles via StyleSheet.create, testIDs on all interactive elements, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL used correctly, MongoDB _id stripped via strip().
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded user test@auction.com / Test1234. Backend register test creates ephemeral users with unique emails (test_<uuid>@auction.com); no cleanup required as they do not interfere with subsequent runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://player-bidding-8.preview.emergentagent.com. Seed user test@auction.com / Test1234 auto-seeded on backend startup. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_auction_api.py runs in ~3.3s. Frontend testIDs follow pattern: bid-card-{id}, chip-{id}-{amount}, place-bid-{id}, pin-{id}, bid-input-{id}, finalize-button, back-button, reset-button, auction-screen. Pools utr_5_5 and utr_5_25 are entirely captains so count=0 and they're auto-skipped; first auctioned player is from UTR 5.0 @ $12,000 (Chandrakant Dharme based on current seed order).
